channel.title: Daily Strategic Briefing (English)
channel.description: A daily strategic intelligence radar: AI and frontier models, energy and electricity, corporate strategy and state-owned enterprises.

item.title: OpenAI Custom Chip, Indonesia 100 GW Solar Launch, Danantara Rp 100 T Restructuring Bill
item.description: A custom inference chip from OpenAI, Indonesia's largest-ever solar program groundbreaking, and a Rp 100 trillion restructuring price tag for BUMN Karya converge to force concrete decisions across all three domains today.

item.title: Indonesia 100 GW Solar Tender Hits Grid Wall; BUMN Karya Drift Continues
item.description: Three Indonesia-specific structural bottlenecks — solar transmission, BUMN Karya stasis, and geothermal concession reform — converge with an OpenAI enterprise privacy shift that forces a contract review for any API user handling sensitive data.

item.title: Geothermal Push, BUMN Deadlock, and OpenAI Privacy Shift Define Monday
item.description: Indonesia's energy and SOE reform agendas hit structural inflection points while OpenAI moves the enterprise data-privacy baseline for frontier AI.

item.title: Nvidia-Cloverleaf equity stake, BUMN Karya deadlock, Indonesia geothermal squeeze
item.description: Three structural shifts converge today: AI compute vendors absorbing infrastructure risk, Indonesia's SOE construction arm stalled in cross-ministry gridlock, and geothermal concession holders facing a government ultimatum.

item.title: Nvidia Takes Infrastructure Exposure; BUMN Karya Deadline Firms; Geothermal Auction Deepens
item.description: Three structural shifts converge: AI capex morphs into project finance, Indonesia's SOE construction sector restructuring moves toward a hard deadline, and the geothermal concession reform accelerates with Pertamina committing publicly at IIGCE 2026.

item.title: Danantara stalls, ESDM opens 14 geothermal blocks, OpenAI locks down API data
item.description: Indonesia's two biggest structural reform threads harden into conditions to plan around, while OpenAI's data-privacy shift redraws enterprise AI procurement.

item.title: OpenAI data-privacy pivot, Indonesia solar land, BUMN Karya impasse, TerraPower-AI nexus
item.description: A cluster of decisions today—on AI data retention, nuclear power for data centres, Indonesian solar land acquisition, and stalled SOE restructuring—each forces a near-term institutional response.

item.title: Danantara BUMN Karya Crunch, Geothermal Push, and ChatGPT Ads Go European
item.description: Indonesia's sovereign wealth complex faces simultaneous stress tests in construction-SOE restructuring and geothermal concession reform, while OpenAI's ad expansion reframes the AI monetisation debate.
